messages:
nina: Quick heads-up — small but sharp uptick in fncall schema rejects on the v2 streaming rollout. Mostly partner routes.

pradeep: link?

nina: https://console.redwood.internal/d/validators?panel=stream_rejects (filtered to canary). Rejects look like enum_mismatch and unexpected_null.

sylvie: any samples?

nina: grabbed one: validator expected status in ["CONFIRMED","FAILED"] but got "confirmed_ok". Example stored fragment: {"body":{"id":"ord_9","status":"confirmed_ok"}}

pradeep: Sounds like legacy labels again. Our adapter maps that in batch path but streaming validates fragments before normalization.

sylvie: short term: can we apply a route-level override to SOFT for /partner/* so hard rejects don't reach customers while we fix?

ops-bot: override applied: shape-gate-canary /partner/* -> SOFT at 2026-03-24T13:02Z by ops-team.

pradeep: Proposal: add tiny telemetry to validation events: validation_phase=(pre_adapter|post_adapter), adapter_applied=(true|false), stream_fragment=(true|false), and auto_fixed=(true|false). That will let console show whether rejects are streaming-preadapter vs true model drift.

sylvie: agree. Console needs a compact tile: fraction of rejects that are auto_fixed by adapters vs hard rejects, by route. Low effort, high signal.

nina: i'll open two PRs: 1) ensure streaming assembles full objects before running validator (delay validation on fragments), 2) telemetry-only PR adding fields and schema bump. I'll include a note for console fields.

pradeep: Also enable per-route sampling of rejects (PII-redacted) to replay after patch. We should store samples for 7 days.

sylvie: security will need to sign off on redaction rules. @morgan can you review once PRs are up?

ops-bot: PR 5751 opened by nina: https://git.redwood.internal/infra/PR/5751 (streaming validation fix).

ops-bot: PR 5752 opened by nina: https://git.redwood.internal/infra/PR/5752 (validation telemetry fields).

pradeep: plan: 1) route override -> SOFT (done), 2) land streaming fix, 3) land telemetry, 4) enable sampling + replay, 5) update console tile and re-evaluate strict gating.

sylvie: timeline? aiming for fixes in ~2-3 hrs and replay same day.

nina: yep aiming for 2h, will ping when PRs merge.
